description: Erection of a rear roof dormer extension, two front roof windows, a replacement single storey rear extension and first floor front infill extension to the house and the reconfiguration of the house's existing two storey side extension roof to increase its height and depth.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (CO1 K.P/01 (Rev C)  Received:  01 July 2020;  CO1 K.P/02; Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Block Plan  Received:  27 April 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be installed in the house's extended and reconfigured roof, first floor front infill extension, rear roof dormer extension and single storey rear extension hereby approved.
